title: This Thanksgiving, Families Are Ditching Turkey for Carved Baloney and Spam
author: Richard Kiselev
description: Americans are choosing cheaper processed meats for Thanksgiving meals as turkey prices soar.
content:
This year, as roast turkey gets more and more expensive, cheaper meats are finding their way onto American dining tables. The American Thanksgiving Turkey Association of Chartertown, Kansas found that the price of an average turkey has risen by more than 60% every year for the past 5 years. Today, the price of a singular bird can reach hundreds of dollars. The Whole Foods close to Stuyvesant’s Chambers Street location was recently spotted selling Amazon’s patented Tiny Turkeys™, each for $20. Each Tiny Turkey™ is about the size of a Cheez-it. This price markup is caused by numerous factors, such as avian flu, inflation, and subscription models infiltrating grocery stores. For example, the two different ProductPass options introduced by Walmart on Wednesday. The ProductPass comes in two variants: Poor Person (free) and Premium Party ($19.99 a day). By purchasing items at Walmart, consumers can “level up” their ProductPasses and receive rewards such as Lucky Drops (contain 0-1 blueberries) and Gems (can be redeemed for blueberries).

With turkey so expensive, Americans are choosing processed meats for their celebratory feasts. The Speculator SuperSurvey found that 40% of the nation’s households have plans to feature a processed meat item in their Thanksgiving dinner. And a whopping 58% of the survey’s participants have thought about processed meat at least once in their lives. This undeniable evidence proves that the nation’s brains are on bologna. A new movement known as CarneCarve has been born, and numerous videos showing off beautifully carved meat prisms have received hundreds of views. This year, the bird is being replaced by the block (of industrially produced cell tissue).

title: The 7-9 Escalator Becomes Sovereign State via Legal Loophole
author: Alec Tiseo
description: A legal loophole makes the 7-9 escalator at Stuyvesant its own sovereign state.
content: In our beloved Stuyvesant High School there exists a system of escalators to transport students up and down 10 floors. However, in the year 1609, the explorer Henry Hudson wrote in his claim to New York: “This claim of land specifically excludes the place where the escalators from the seventh to ninth floor in Stuyvesant Secondary School shall be built in the year 1992.” This claim was not found until our year 2025. Since all further claims to the state / city / land of “New York” (and by extension the United States of America) include this restriction, the land occupied by the 7-9 escalator has been found to officially be an unclaimed territory. A well known historian of the Stuyvesant Soviet Party, Maldivin Liner, decided to take up this loophole with the Stuyvesant administration by directly staking a claim for the party on the land. The flag of the SSP now stands tall above the piles of backpacks and bodies of students who could not make it up the escalator because of the power outages prior to the land claim. The Stuyvesant administration claims that “the claim is valid” and that “there’s nothing we can do about it. But we’re not cleaning up those bodies”. Stuyvesant super senior Axel D. Tissue expressed his feelings: “NOOOOO!!!! I NEED THIS ESCALATOR!!!”. Only SSP members can pass through the border checkpoint, boosting party registration by 70%.

title: Stuyvesant Cult Found Performing Ritual in Boys Bathroom, One Fatality Confirmed
author: Sic Steven
description: A Peter Stuyvesant cult ritual leads to a student fatality in the boys bathroom.
content:
On November 14th, 2025, at approximately 4:32 PM, a mysterious group of four hooded students entered the boys bathroom on the second floor. Eyewitnesses report that they locked themselves into the third stall and that they were reported performing very suspicious activity, such as “incantations” and “flooding the toilet”.

Stuyvesant senior Chucky Hao crawled under the stall to investigate the situation. Eyewitnesses report hearing yelling as soon as he crawled through, as well as the sounds of bones breaking. The stall door finally unlocked, and Chucky was found lying facedown in a puddle of toilet water and blood after being stomped on(58 bones broken in his body).The mysterious group turned out to be members of the underground cult that worshipped none other than Peter Stuyvesant, the historical figure of Stuyvesant High School. They were performing a ritual in the bathroom to 'resurrect our lord and saviour' (after interrogation). They were reported to have clogged the toilet with milk and Cheerios offered during school breakfast hours to create a mysterious concoction of cereal, milk, and toilet water.

Three witnesses immediately reported the incident to Principal Yu, who took the culprits to custody on the spot. Interestingly, the incident did not seem to be documented at the police station that day, and yet to be mentioned on the news. Furthermore, this incident has not yet been publicly addressed at Stuyvesant, raising further suspicions of Principal Yu’s possible connection with the cult.

Chucky was immediately rushed to the hospital, but sadly confirmed to have died on the weekend after succumbing to his wounds.

title: Stuyvesant Soviet Party Now Leads In Polls
author: Richard Kiselev
description: The Stuyvesant Soviet Party surges ahead in student elections.
content:
In a move that shocked all three people who care about student elections, the Stuyvesant Soviet Party, or SSP, is now leading in polls. The Speculator’s official Crazy Caucus Championship reports 79% of students, and 94% of freshmen, support the SSP and would like to see SSP leaders in office. In contrast, the Pizza Party is currently at just 27% support. The Stuyvesant Spectator, this school’s lesser known #2 newspaper, has claimed that the Crazy Caucus Championship is an “absolutely ridiculous attempt at a survey”. According to their own polls, the SSP is at a 0% approval rate. In fact, on their polling website, all parties are at 0% approval rate, except for the PrinciPAL Party, which is officially sponsored by the school’s administration and has a 100%.

Kingston G. Baranov is the chairman of the Stuyvesant Soviet Party. Often going by just his initials, Baranov has written a series of “Grant Socialist Thesis Statements That Express Our Numerous Goals to be Completed by April 2026”. These “April Theses”, as they are called, express the many plans of Baranov, including the formation of a Committee for Stuyvesant Security, a system of “work camps” where students will be forced to do mental math in the freezer, and an improvement to the current free school lunch system.

Critics of Baranov and the SSP have called his plans “Project 2026”. But they’re seemingly popular with students, especially the freshmen. “Students of the school, unite!”, is the SSP’s slogan. It can be found in hallways, on the escalators, and on bathroom doors, written in Black Licorice Mr. Sketch Scented Marker.

title: Is Restricting the Use of Elevators a Health Hazard?
author: Bendova Babi
description: Debate erupts over elevator restrictions at Stuyvesant High School after student injuries.
content:
Stuyvesant High School is known for its escalators that transport thousands of students up and down the 10-story building every day. However, students are forbidden from the use of the elevators, which are mainly used by its school faculty. The only scenario where students are allowed to use the elevator is if they have a medical condition, in which an elevator pass is given to the student. This has sparked debate over whether this system is fair and liable.

On Monday, November 24th, three students suffered severe injuries after bolting from the first floor to the tenth in order to get to class. They were diagnosed with multiple muscle injuries stemming from overexertion, as well as severe cardiovascular problems. They were also reported to have tripped over one another multiple times, resulting in bone fractures as well. The escalator to the 9th floor did not work at the time, which caused the three to collapse on the escalator, causing others to trip and resulting in multiple injuries.

“It’s not just teacher-student privileges, it’s a health hazard,” one victim criticized when being interviewed at the hospital. “Only betas with health issues get elevator passes, and this goofy ahh rule just almost chopped me and my gang”, seemingly referring to the “sickcycle2021”, his Clash Royale clan. “ARE YOU HAPPY NOW?” he screamed hysterically as he threw a pillow across the room.

The students are to be given an extended period of elevator passes once released from the hospital. This incident highlights ongoing concerns about a system that creates safety hazards and fosters feelings of inequality. School officials have yet to release any official statement regarding this incident, and the 7-9th floor escalator continues to stay out of service. The Stuyvesant Soviet Party has declared the catastrophe a “classic example of when capitalism is acting naughty”.

title: Earthquake Starts after Freshman Steps into Cone-Surrounded Section of Gym
author: Figarland Shanks
description: A freshman steps past cones in the gym, triggering a minor earthquake.
content:
Students at Stuyvesant High School were caught off guard yesterday afternoon when a minor earthquake rattled a section of the third-floor gym, just moments after a student stepped into an area that had been cordoned off with bright orange cones.

According to witnesses, the blocked-off section had been marked for maintenance after staff noticed unusual floor vibrations earlier in the week. Despite the warnings, one student, curious about what the cones were protecting, briefly crossed the boundary. Almost immediately, the ground shuddered, sending a ripple through the gym floor and causing nearby basketballs to fly across the court. The quake, later identified as a minor seismic event, caused no injuries and only minimal structural impact. Still, the timing left many students nervously joking that the gym cones had been doing more than marking a hazard; they had been guarding the school from seismic scenarios. School officials have temporarily closed the entire third-floor gym for inspection. As for the student who stepped past the cones, he’s become a minor legend in the hallways—although administrators remind everyone that safety boundaries exist for a reason.

title: Intergalactic Investment Advice from a Guest Writer
author: Gleesties "Zorfae" Smorpian
description: An alien guest writer provides humorous investment advice for intergalactic civilizations.
content: Good readers of the Speculator, I have news for you. I trust that you are advanced enough to act accordingly. If you are anything like the other 502 civilizations of what you call the “Local Group,” you are on the course to abolish money within around 500 years. It is pretty clear that the current sentient inhabitants of Earth strongly believe in what they call “money”, but I am sure you aren’t a blind devotee to this cult and will listen to me and invest in proper things before the bubble pops. As a gift from me, here are some recommended investments to keep wealth beyond 500 years: Dark Energy, Quantum Energia, Antimatter Generators, Entropy Credits, Tunneling Yield Warrants, Boltzmann Engines.

title: Maintenance Threatens to Go On Strike If Agnon-Burns Elected to Caucus
author: Richard Kiselev
description: Stuyvesant Laborers Union threatens strike due to anarcho-capitalist candidate proposals.
content:
Out of the 17 candidate pairs running for Freshman Caucus, one pair’s ideas resulted in threats from the Stuyvesant Laborers Union (SLU). William Agnon and Magnus Burns are two self-proclaimed anarcho-capitalists who have pushed forward some controversial ideas about the future of Stuyvesant. While other candidates propose extra tutoring or 'anti-stress cuddles', Agnon and Burns are calling on Stuyvesant’s Labor Office Workers (SLOW) to replace all 'non-essential federal employees' with AI. 'Minimum wage getting high? Rely on AI!' is one of their major slogans.

In response to this, the SLU has called for a strike of all janitors, mechanics, IT staff, and other non-administrative workers. Principal Yu officially barred the anarcho-capitalists from running, citing concerns of labor shortages. 'We love you, workers!' Yu proclaimed in an email last night. He then felt the need to clarify that 'we love how you do your job. It’s not like I like you, or anything'.

title: Stuyvesant Students Get Special McDonald’s Menu
author: Anonymous
description: McDonald’s collaborates with Stuyvesant High School to offer themed meals.
content:
Stuyvesant students that visit the Chambers St. McDonald’s after school, for lunch, and during free periods, the manager of the nearest McDonalds, made a deal with the administration of Stuyvesant High School. The administration will give Roderick Klein, the manager, advertisement space and tantalizing posters inside the well-populated high school. In return, for the next month, McDonald’s will feature Stuyvesant-themed menu items, such as the so-called 'Stuyvesant Meal' with teacher blind-box trading cards, the 'Pro Scientia' Burger and the 'Big Yu', with trademarked Stuyvesant Sauce (76% tears!!) and 'I’m so fried' Fries. To entice Stuyvesant students to eat all 3 meals of the day at their healthy establishment, McDonald’s has also introduced 'Peter’s Pancakes' after school mascot Peter Stuyvesant.

Only time will tell if this will entice more people to go to the McDonalds, but many students express excitement over the collaboration. Jordan Maller, a 65 year old super senior, stated that 'it’s good to get the younguns involved in American tradition' and that 'back in [his] day, the only two items on the McDonald’s menu were 'Mickey' and 'Donald'.'

title: Stuyvesant Introduces 'Stress-Free' Classes Taught By TikTok Influencers
author: Bendova Babi
description: Principal Yu introduces influencer-led 'stress-free' classes at Stuyvesant High School.
content:
The recent student burnout that resulted in more than a hundred students getting sent to a psychiatric hospital has taken the world of school-related social media (Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, etc.) by storm. Rumors have increasingly circulated around Stuyvesant’s impact on students physically and emotionally, hurting its reputation.

To “counter and restore Stuyvesant to its former glory”, Principal Yu has officially introduced “stress-free” classes to be phased in “sometime in 2026”. These classes will be held by online influencers and Stuy alumni that became influencers on popular social media platforms, notably TikTok, the video-sharing platform with around 2 billion active users. Students will master not only doomscrolling and Gen beta brainrot/slang, but will learn to become influencers themselves. During the classes, students are allowed to violate the cell phone/device policy either for 'educational' purposes or for 'surfing the web, isn’t that what kids are doing nowadays'.

“The next generation is cooked anyways, so let them boil,” Principal Yu said. People speculate if Principal Yu truly wants to make a change or if he’s just trying to save his reputation as 'Stuyvesant’s Coolest Principal of 2025'.
